The new no-track path can discard an existing board continuation when ownership evidence is incomplete, unreadable, or inconsistent, and it also drops a required freshness check. These are correctness issues in the handoff mechanism.

Full review comments:

- [P1] Do not treat hash-shaped text as proof of track ownership — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\.claude\hooks\lib\session-report.js:146-146
  When a row contains a commit-looking token that is not returned by `myCommits` (for example, a trailerless sibling-repository commit), `boardTrack` returns null but `무주줄` excludes that row solely because it matches this regex. If it is the only such row, the handoff takes the `모호 === 0` path, says the board need not be reopened, and starts a new track even though the row may belong to the current session. A hash-shaped marker is not proof that the current session was ruled out; verify ownership or keep the row ambiguous.

- [P1] Require a readable board before creating a new track — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\.claude\hooks\lib\session-report.js:205-212
  When `무주줄` returns `null` because `docs/세션보드.md` cannot be read, this fallback still ends with an instruction to create a new track. A read failure does not establish that the current session has no board row, so a transient permission or filesystem error can cause a duplicate track and lose the existing continuation; reserve the automatic new-track instruction for a confirmed zero, and require the board to be read otherwise.

- [P2] Keep the latest-commit check in no-track handoffs — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\.claude\hooks\lib\session-report.js:210-212
  The previous no-track handoff ended with `git log --oneline -10`, but the new branch removes that freshness check. If another session commits after this handoff is generated, the next session can choose work from stale history and collide with it; the repository explicitly requires this check immediately before starting work (`CLAUDE.md:77`).

- [P2] Use one board snapshot for both no-track decisions — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\.claude\hooks\lib\session-report.js:162-162
  `buildHandoff` reads the board once through `boardTrack` and then reads it again through `무주줄`. With the documented concurrent sessions, another edit between those calls can make the track lookup and ambiguity count describe different versions, allowing the `모호 === 0` branch to claim that no own row exists; read and parse one snapshot for both decisions (`CLAUDE.md:72`).

- [P2] Classify board rows without requiring an ISO date — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\.claude\hooks\lib\session-report.js:144-144
  `무주줄` only considers lines containing a `YYYY-MM-DD` token, while the existing board guard treats any non-header, non-separator table row as data (`.claude/hooks/board-guard.js:89-95`). A legacy or manually entered row with another date format or a blank date is therefore skipped; if it is the current unmarked row, the count can become zero and the handoff will incorrectly skip the safe board recheck.

지적.제목: 선언 로그에서 비학생·DEMO 행을 제외하지 않음
지적.근거: `profiles`에는 보존된 학부모·강사·원장 행과 DEMO 학생이 포함되지만, 현재 경로는 A열만 읽고 모든 행의 AO/CB/DA 값을 추가한다. 비학생 또는 DEMO 행에 값이 있으면 학습자 증거로 기록되어 이후 분석이나 훈련 데이터를 오염시킬 수 있다.

지적.제목: 자체 선언 로그의 읽기·추가 과정이 직렬화되지 않음
지적.근거: 두 개의 `nightJobs` 또는 수동 `selfDeclareLogNightly_` 실행이 겹치면, 두 실행이 서로 쓰기 전에 동일한 이력과 `getLastRow()`를 읽고 같은 추가 범위에 서로 다른 배치를 쓸 수 있다. 나중 쓰기가 먼저 쓰인 기록을 덮어써 append-only 및 멱등 로깅 보장이 깨질 수 있다.
지적.수정방향: 읽기-차이 계산-쓰기 전체 구간에서 ScriptLock을 유지하거나 충돌에 안전한 추가 키를 사용한다.

원문:
The new history logger can hide deletion of its own storage, record non-student/demo data, and lose records under overlapping executions. These affect the reliability and integrity of the newly introduced learning evidence.

Full review comments:

- [P1] Let the watchdog detect a missing self-declare log — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\엔진_콘텐츠AI.js:349-349
  When an active `profiles` sheet exists and `self_declare_log` is deleted or renamed, the nightly logger recreates an empty sheet before the weekly `systemWatchdog` runs. The watchdog then sees the name as present, so prior append-only history can be lost without an alert. Create the sheet during setup and make the recorder fail when it is missing, or otherwise preserve the missing state for the watchdog.

- [P2] Filter non-student and demo rows from declaration logs — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\엔진_콘텐츠AI.js:348-356
  `profiles` contains preserved parent/teacher/director rows and DEMO students, but this path reads only column A and appends every row's AO/CB/DA value. If a non-student or demo row has a value, it is recorded as learner evidence and can contaminate later analytics or training. Read the role column and exclude non-students and `DEMO-` rows before building `rows`.

- [P2] Serialize the self-declare read-and-append — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\엔진_콘텐츠AI.js:360-360
  If two `nightJobs` or manual `selfDeclareLogNightly_` executions overlap, both can read the same history and `getLastRow()` before either writes, then write different batches to the same append range. The later write can overwrite records from the first, violating the append-only and idempotent logging guarantees. Hold a ScriptLock across the read-diff-write sequence or use a collision-safe append key.

원문:
The new serialization and filtering are undermined by a non-reentrant lock path that fails during the very shrink event it should report, while lock contention can silently lose nightly observations. The HWM check also misses in-place record deletion.

Full review comments:

- [P1] Avoid reacquiring the script lock in the shrink alert path — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\엔진_콘텐츠AI.js:357-357
  When the log has shrunk, this call still holds `LockService.getScriptLock()`. Since `DIGEST_MODE` is true (`Code.js:841`), `adminMail()` tries to `waitLock(30000)` on the same non-reentrant lock, times out, and prevents the shrink warning and HWM update; the failure then repeats nightly. Release the lock before sending or enqueue the alert without reacquiring it.

- [P1] Retry instead of silently skipping a lock-contended snapshot — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\엔진_콘텐츠AI.js:354-354
  If another trigger or manual execution holds the script-wide lock for more than 30 seconds, this returns `0` and `safeRun('selfDeclareLog', ...)` treats it as success. The other holder may not be recording declarations, so a value that changes again before the next nightly run is irrecoverably missed; retry or surface the timeout instead of dropping the observation.

- [P2] Detect cleared records rather than only a shorter last row — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\엔진_콘텐츠AI.js:385-386
  `getLastRow()` only reports the tail index of non-empty content. Clearing a middle record, or clearing A:C while a later row/date remains, leaves `now` at the old HWM and bypasses the alert even though append-only evidence was deleted. Track a content/count hash or otherwise validate the records, not just the tail index.

지적.제목: 강의 요약을 숙제 인센티브 집계에서 제외
지적.근거: 강의 요약이 hw_feedback 행으로 기록되지만 엔진_운영배치.js의 calcTeacherStats는 학생·날짜 조합을 모두 숙제 제출로 세고 A:C 열만 읽는다. 주말 학생이 강의 요약을 제출하면 숙제 제출률과 교사 인센티브 지급액이 부풀려질 수 있다.
지적.수정방향: 강의: 행을 집계에서 제외하거나 숙제 지표와 강의 요약 지표를 분리한다.

지적.제목: 강의 커버리지 분모를 중복 제거 키와 일치
지적.근거: 큐는 학생, 강의 ID, 요약을 요구하고 (학생, 날짜, 강의) 중복 행을 합치지만 요약총은 학생 ID와 요약만 사용해 원시 행을 센다. 학생이 하루에 같은 강의를 두 번 제출하면 배치는 카드 하나를 만들지만 보고서는 영구적으로 1/2를 표시하며, 강의 ID가 없는 행도 큐에 들어가지 않는데 집계된다.
지적.수정방향: 분모를 큐와 동일한 정규 후보 키에서 산출한다.

지적.제목: AI backlog 상태 확인에 강의 행 포함
지적.근거: aiFeedbackBatch_에는 강의 행이 추가되지만 aiFeedbackHealth_는 숙제폼_응답과 숙제폼_포인터만으로 backlog를 계산한다. 숙제가 비어 있고 강의 요약이 대기 중인 상태에서 비어 있지 않은 API 키가 만료되었거나 일시적으로 실패하면 preflight/watchdog가 실제 큐 정체에도 backlog를 0으로 보고할 수 있다.
지적.수정방향: 대기 중인 강의 키와 가장 오래된 날짜를 health 계산에 포함한다.

지적.제목: 숙제ID에서 강의 접두사 예약
지적.근거: 숙제ID 폼 필드는 사용자가 수정할 수 있지만 이 조회는 강의:로 시작하는 모든 숙제ID를 강의 원본으로 취급한다. 일치하는 강의 요약보다 먼저 해당 숙제 행이 존재하면 done에 기록되어 실제 요약이 학생·날짜·강의 조합에서 건너뛰어지고 커버리지 보고서에서도 잘못 집계된다.
지적.수정방향: 숙제 제출에서 예약된 강의: 접두사를 거부하거나 이스케이프한다.

지적.제목: Exclude lecture feedback from homework scoring
지적.근거: When a lecture summary is processed, this append writes a `강의:<lectureId>` source into `hw_feedback`, but `calcTeacherStats` calculates the homework numerator from columns A:C and deduplicates only by `student_id|date`. Thus a student who submits only a lecture summary is counted as a homework submission, inflating the homework rate, incentive score, and potentially teacher pay.
지적.수정방향: Filter lecture-source rows before scoring or store them separately.

지적.제목: Track lecture summaries in the AI backlog health check
지적.근거: This adds `lecture_views` as a second input to `aiFeedbackBatch_`, but `aiFeedbackHealth_` still derives the backlog only from `숙제폼_응답` and `숙제폼_포인터`, which is what the watchdog reports. When homework is caught up but lecture summaries are pending, the operational checks can report no AI backlog and fail to expose an unprocessed lecture queue.
지적.수정방향: Include lecture candidates and completed keys in the health calculation.

지적.제목: Alert on partially processed lecture summaries
지적.근거: The warning is emitted only when `강의요약` is zero (`요약총 && !강의요약`). If one of N summaries is appended and the queue then stalls, `dataCoverageMonthly_` sees no `⚠️` and sends no coverage email even though the report is incomplete.

After a reviewer changes those cards to `노출`, they are already past `오류뱅크_포인터` and are permanently omitted from `error_bank`. Keep pending rows retryable or track a status-aware cursor.
